name: bobmasterbillie-reference
description: Static reference page (no build step, no framework) + four Vercel Functions in /api that handle the password-gated writes to Supabase. This file exists only so Vercel installs @supabase/supabase-js for those functions — index.html itself needs no build step and no dependencies (DOMPurify and supabase-js load via CDN in the browser).
